# registration number

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:registrationNumber`](gmeow-registrationNumber.md)

- **Category:** property

The registry registration number of a trademark (e.g. a CIPO / USPTO / WIPO number).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:registrationNumber`](gmeow-registrationNumber.md) from [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the registry registration number of a trademark — a CIPO, USPTO, or WIPO identifier — on its [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) relator.

### Avoid when

- Avoid setting it on an unregistered common-law mark (there is no number — use [`gmeow:trademarkStatusUnregistered`](../individuals/gmeow-trademarkStatusUnregistered.md)) and avoid putting it on the [`gmeow:Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md); it belongs on the right.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:registrationNumber`](gmeow-registrationNumber.md) once per [`Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) (functional) when the mark is registered or pending; pair it with [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](gmeow-trademarkStatus.md) and the issuing registry.

### Examples

- ex:blackcatTM [`gmeow:registrationNumber`](gmeow-registrationNumber.md) "TMA1234567".
